description: Agent-facing tiered workflow for dxCore console: orientation without one-shot docs; runtime truth on deployed build; forks and hypothesis confirmation.
content_policy: Functional/process only. No credential or secret fields. Do not paste full console_guide/HTML into repo from Confluence.

staleness_doctrine: Confluence and Jira are SURFACE explanations and examples—they are often outdated, version-generic, or not aligned with Corner’s fork line.
Never treat a Confluence excerpt as executable truth for a CRTQA/PROD-equivalent host; always reconcile with runtime help on THAT deployment.
The Autogenerated console guide attachment space (frozen HTML exports) is archive-only—not a catalogue for current builds.
XT procedural pages and QAPORTAL ticket pages may show command patterns worth trying; parity with deployed console is uncertain until verified.
truth_hierarchy: 1_deployed_console: Commands and modules present on target JVM/session (via show console_guide, grep, dump_to micro-probes)
3_live_atlassian: confluence_search + confluence_get_page + jira_get_issue for narrative, CRT/XT/DXCORE context
4_static_attachments_lowest_trust: Old HTML/XML exports unless confirmed regenerated for your line/version

tier_sequence.label: Read this JSON + multiplex README (no MCP wall yet)
tier_sequence.goal: Load doctrine, tooling paths, and tier order—avoid one-shot Confluence dumps.

tier_sequence.label: Narrow MCP skim (examples only)
tier_sequence.goal: Pick 1–2 pages or one Jira operational block when task needs domain wording; cite page_id—not full body in chat logs.

tier_sequence.label: Establish or reuse scripted session → query deployed console
tier_sequence.goal: After orientation, derive concrete verbs from TARGET: show console_guide slice; grep subsets; minimal dump_to.

tier_sequence.label: Hypothesis confirmation loop
tier_sequence.goal: Run smallest command proving/disproving assumption; archive transcript under temp/crtqa-console/invoke-*.log when using Invoke-CrtqaDxConsole.ps1; revise plan.

repo_tooling.notes: Transcripts append under gitignored temp/crtqa-console/ when using Invoke-* .

runtime_commands_reference.description: Meta-commands worth naming ONLY—syntax and full verb list come from deployed show console_guide / grep.
typical_discovery_flow: show console_guide (or substring search via grep helper if overloaded output)
dump_to guide.html show console_guide output=HTML for offline slice—do not commit that HTML to repo
grep <needle> pipe into smaller windows when guide is huge

hypothesis_confirmation: Prefer one minimal console incantation that distinguishes two theories (syntax vs privilege vs env vs stale doc).
If scripted (Invoke-CrtqaDxConsole), keep batches short; inspect invoke-*.log; extend only after prior output parses.
If interactive tab is available, correlate human-visible prompt with scripted stderr (multiplex quirks, sudo, dumb TTY).
When Confluence/Jira contradicts observed behaviour, OPEN A BRANCH assume doc drift—capture evidence in session notes/handoff—not silent trust to wiki.

mcp_discovery.confluence: confluence_search with narrow CQL (type=page AND (space in CT, XT, DXCORE, QAPORTAL subtree)), then confluence_get_page(page_id)—see confluence_catalog for anchors.
mcp_discovery.jira_operational_text: jira_get_issue / jira_search for CRTQA, CRT*, DXCORE—operational/description fields may contain pasted console transcripts; validate on host.

confluence_catalog.use_for: High-level behaviours (starting console via dx start console, repeat, grep, dump_to concepts). Maintainer-updated prose but still verify on deploy.

confluence_catalog.title: XT Used APIs and Specifications (new)
confluence_catalog.use_for: Pointer to dumping console_guide to HTML locally from live session—not a canonical verb list stored in wiki.

confluence_catalog.title: dxCore Home
confluence_catalog.use_for: Stash/Jira/process links and deep navigation—not per-command correctness for Corner forks.

confluence_catalog.title: Stage 2: Platform Configuration
confluence_catalog.use_for: Example discovery-style commands quoted as angles (account_group_hierarchy show, show m_settings_domains, etc.). Treat as mnemonic—syntax may drift.

confluence_catalog.title: Autogenerated console guide
confluence_catalog.use_for: Historical attachment HTML snapshots only—not primary reference for Corner/CRTQA workflows.

sections.when_to_use: Running batches from Cursor on Windows CRTQA/multiplex setups.
actions: If session missing Start-CrtqaConsoleSession.ps1; batches via Invoke-CrtqaDxConsole.ps1.

sections.when_to_use: After repo orientation; before trusting examples from markdown tickets.
actions: Enumerate relevant slices from LIVE console using runtime_commands_reference.typical_discovery_flow.
If scripted path cannot allocate TTY for heavy interactive features, pivot to narrower batch or interactive Enter-CrtqaConsole.ps1 fork.

sections.when_to_use: Need domain phrasing / historical procedure for Corner or upstream XT lines.
actions: Scoped confluence_search: QAPORTAL subtree ancestor=497097273 OR space CT OR space XT; cap results.
Extract EXAMPLE snippets only—re-verify each line on tier_session_runtime.
If ticket-specific,Jira CRTQA CRTBL DXCORE before broad space crawl.

sections.when_to_use: Observed mismatch between doc and behaviour.

decision_forks.situation: Command from wiki returns syntax/unknown command on deployed console.
then: Try grep/console_guide for closest modern name.
Check Jira operational paste for typo vs doc drift.
Try alternate surface (REST/DB/widget) ONLY if playbook allows—not as silent substitute.

decision_forks.situation: Multiplex Invoke fails or empty transcript while interactive Enter works.
then: Confirm session.active.json + master plink PID alive.
Confirm sudo/credential DPAPI intact (rerun Stop+Start when rotating password).
Reduce batch to dumb-TTY-safe commands—may need interactive path for prompts.

decision_forks.situation: Insufficient privilege for operation as ctqa or selected principal.
then: Document required role from error text—do NOT stash passwords in repo chat.
Escalate via operator for sudoers/policy—agent documents gap with repro console lines.

decision_forks.situation: Heavy guide output overwhelms token budget.
then: Use grep narrowing or dump_to to local temp file inspected in slices—not pasted wholesale into model context.
